answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in an autonomous AI agent economy, networks implement cryptoeconomic staking where agents must lock native tokens to participate in consensus, much like securing a wharf against unauthorized cargo. If an attacker attempts to forge dozens of fake agent identities, they must immobilize capital for each node. This economic friction scales linearly, rendering large-scale deception financially ruinous, akin to the immense mass required to alter a comet trajectory.
